svg.title: Options page control guide
svg.desc: Three pages of mix knob settings with MEDIA colour and blink indications. Full text version in OPTIONS.md.

g.text: 2. Change page: tap ASSIGN. The pulsing mix
LED marks the page (F / D/W / R).
3. Change a setting: turn its knob; it
saves one second after you stop (the page
4. Close: hold ASSIGN 3 s, or press any
other button except SEED on page 1 with
Scale selected: short taps step the scale.
Move a knob more than 10% of its travel
Wait one second before powering off.
